name: Omatracker
author: nate
description: Theme-aware tracker for which programs are focused and for how long, with daily limits.

barWidget.description: Focused program and today's time. Click for usage and limits.

schema.label: Show the program name
schema.description: Off shows only the time. The panel always shows names.

schema.label: Warn at percent of limit
schema.description: The bar shifts to the accent color, and a notification is sent, at this share of a daily limit.

schema.label: Stop counting after idle (minutes)
schema.description: Time is not counted once the session has been idle this long.
